column1: This ledger records the pre-rewrite disposition of every commit reachable from
origin/main and origin/ci-agents. The new_hash column is intentionally blank
until the protocol-v2 rewrite is complete. Re-run
scripts/agents/audit-commits.py on the rewritten refs and fill it by ancestry
mapping; do not rewrite historical rows.
Known pre-rewrite counts: 133 commits; 57 stale assistant identities;
12 long-body commits; 4 split trailer blocks; 1 missing explanatory body.
